release_read.basis: FY27 cc revenue guide cut to 1-2% from 1.5-3%, below even the bearish broker case (Emkay 1.5-2.5%) after a 24% sector run-up, with Q2 at the low end of the cc QoQ range (1.2%), margin 21.0% vs 21.2% consensus and EPS $0.20 vs $0.21; the $5.2bn large-deal TCV (vs $2-3bn expected) and AI revenue +29% QoQ are the offsets that keep this inside the 7.2% implied move.

release.released_at_note: Company schedule (hunt, Infosys press release of 2026-10-19) put results at about 15:45 IST = 06:15 ET; the StockTitan copy of the release is stamped 08:34 ET. Exact wire time not verified.
release.headline: Infosys: Differentiated AI strategy and a sharp focus on value unlock propels 29% sequential growth in AI revenues

vs_bar.note: Consensus is in rupees (Rs 49,108 cr, Bloomberg via BusinessToday); the rupee actual was not in the release copy read, so no surprise is computed.
Consensus is the midpoint of a 1.1-1.7% poll range; actual at the low end.

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback, 3 estimates)

vs_bar.note: HDFC expected $2-3bn (midpoint used); actual includes one deal over $2bn, 62% net new. Strong beat.

key_line.detail: Cut to 1-2% from 1.5-3.0%: midpoint down 75bp to 1.5%, below Emkay's 1.5-2.5% and HDFC's 2-3% expectations; close to the most bearish preview (Nuvama 1.0-2.5%).

guidance.detail: FY27 cc revenue 1-2% (was 1.5-3.0%); operating margin 20-22% retained. Street had a trim as base case but to 1.5-2.5% or 2-3%.

call.detail: Infosys normally holds its analyst call in the Indian evening, around 09:00 ET, so it is likely running through the open and the first half hour; not verified for this quarter. The call is where the $5.2bn TCV and AI growth can be pushed against the guide cut, which is a risk to a short held into the session.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions found by 09:18 ET (Indian brokers will publish over the weekend, before NSE trades Monday). Coverage found so far reports the guide cut; the StockTitan quote page shows the ADR down about 8% on 158x relative volume.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 12.14 vs prev close 13.22 = -8.2%, beyond the 7.2% implied move and past the frozen -5.0% release read. Active pre-market (120 prints, 20 in the last 30 min, last at 09:11, not stale) that sagged from a 12.88 high to the 12.10 low into the open, so momentum is still down. Market slightly weak (SPY -0.4%). Short is +7.2% from entry 13.045.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a guide trim after a sector run-up; the trim came deeper than the street's base case (1-2% vs 1.5-2.5%/2-3%). The strong TCV is the one line that argues the other way.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market traded actively right up to 09:11 and sits at its low, so the open should hold nearly all of the -8.2%. A gap beyond the implied move and beyond what the release supports, a crowded and covering ADR short (109M shares) and a call around the open that can lean on the $5.2bn TCV make a partial fade toward the close by 10:00 more likely than not; the late sag in the pre-market is the evidence against.

recommendation.reason: De verlaging van de omzetverwachting bevestigt de short, maar de koers staat voorbeurs al ruim 8% lager, meer dan de opties verwachtten en meer dan het bericht op zichzelf rechtvaardigt. Met veel uitstaande shorts die kunnen terugkopen en een analistencall rond de opening die de sterke orderinstroom ($5,2 mrd) kan benadrukken, is de kans op een gedeeltelijk herstel groter dan op verdere daling: neem de winst op de openingskoers.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 duidelijk onder 12,10 dollar wegzakt met aanhoudende handel, of als de call een verdere verzwakking in het tweede halfjaar aankondigt, is aanhouden tot 13:00 (de standaardregel) te verdedigen.
